name: useHealthConnect
summary: Platform health records, steps, and sensor vitals telemetry.
plain: Inspects Android Health Connect framework availability, system step counter hardware, and sensor vitals. Integrates unified health telemetry on Android 14+ without simulation.
description: Backed by android.health.connect system framework on Android 14+, PackageManager healthdata provider detection, and hardware Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER / Sensor.TYPE_HEART_RATE HAL drivers. Nothing is simulated: reports real device health telemetry availability.

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Whether Health Connect is available on the device.

returns.name: hasStepCounter
returns.desc: Whether physical hardware step counter sensor is present.

returns.name: hasHeartRateSensor
returns.desc: Whether hardware heart rate sensor is present.

returns.name: stepSensorName
returns.desc: Hardware sensor name (e.g. Google Step Counter).

returns.name: isFrameworkIntegrated
returns.desc: Whether Health Connect is built into the OS (Android 14+).

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-probe Health Connect framework and hardware sensors.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Re-probe Health Connect framework and hardware sensors.
